meta.scope: Official README component-sum benchmark scope plus explicit CUDA Graph capture/replay probes and torch.profiler overhead breakdown.

measurement_notes.host_enqueue_ms: Python/PyTorch call wall time before explicit synchronize.
measurement_notes.sync_wait_after_enqueue_ms: Explicit synchronize wait; mostly outstanding GPU work, not pure sync overhead.
measurement_notes.cpu_cuda_launch_runtime_ms: CPU runtime spent in cudaLaunchKernel/cuLaunchKernel/cudaGraphLaunch during profiler collection.
measurement_notes.device_idle_gap_sum_ms: Profiler CUDA timeline gaps between device events; includes launch/handoff/stream idle effects and is profiler-perturbed.
measurement_notes.cpu_aten_alloc_like_self_ms: CPU self time of allocation/copy-like aten ops; not a direct allocator-only measurement.
measurement_notes.cuda_alloc_free: cudaMalloc/cudaFree runtime events after warmup; zero means the caching allocator avoided request-path device allocations.
